Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1293191 (Transcriptional regulator ERG). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
